central_idea_and_construction: A compact cozy pixel-art sprout in a squat terracotta pot, designed on one coarse square grid. Two generous connected paddle-shaped leaves: left leaf rises one grid step higher and bends inward, right leaf reaches farther outward. Short thick stem; pot is wider than tall with a broad apricot rim and gently stair-stepped rounded lower corners. Four controlled solid colors, large readable clusters, one small darker green patch per leaf at most. No tiny soil specks or detached pixels. Crisp consistent pixel steps; warm inviting game sprite, not a corporate eco logo. Centered roughly 60% width and 68% height on white. No extra heart, sparkle, text, scene, shadow, gradient, dithering or border.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Uneven leaf pair, short stem and low broad pot.
specific_risk: Native raster may approximate a pixel grid; verify edges without claiming integer-grid certification.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
